candidates.name: Premises below 30 Mbps indicator
candidates.gate: Aggregated indicator; exact UPRN check required.

candidates.name: ONS confidence-interval limitation
candidates.gate: Do not manufacture statistical intervals.

candidates.name: ONS aggregation divergence
candidates.gate: Reconcile methodology and geography before scoring.

candidates.name: May 2026 OMR publication state
candidates.gate: Planned publication is not delivered data.

candidates.name: Next NR OMR cycle
candidates.gate: Future collection cannot be treated as current evidence.

candidates.name: OMR refresh cadence
candidates.gate: Stale supplier submissions require refresh checks.

candidates.name: OMR commercial-plan horizon
candidates.gate: Planned build must remain separate from current coverage.

candidates.name: OMR and Ofcom corroboration
candidates.value: Supplier returns combined with Connected Nations
candidates.gate: Cross-source dates and geographies must align.

candidates.name: Wholesale broadband scope
candidates.gate: Do not map leased-line presence to residential service.

candidates.name: White classification
candidates.value: No qualifying network and none likely within three years
candidates.gate: Classification vintage and UPRN hash must be verified.

candidates.name: Grey classification
candidates.value: One qualifying network current or planned
candidates.gate: Current and planned states must be split.

candidates.name: Black classification
candidates.value: Two or more qualifying networks current or planned
candidates.gate: Supplier independence and time state must be preserved.

candidates.name: Under Review classification
candidates.gate: Never promote to confirmed current coverage.

candidates.name: September 2025 UPRN dataset
candidates.gate: Use corrected February 2026 files only.

candidates.name: Historical-intervention incompleteness
candidates.value: Vouchers, GigaHubs and Superfast not comprehensive
candidates.gate: Absence is not evidence of non-delivery.

candidates.name: Supplier-name correction
candidates.gate: Require corrected version and content hash.

candidates.name: Map Your Mobile resolution
candidates.gate: Spatial cells are not parcel polygons.

candidates.name: Mobile good-coverage threshold
candidates.gate: Prediction is probabilistic and device-dependent.

candidates.name: All-four-MNO geographic good coverage
candidates.gate: Historic national aggregate, not current local service.

candidates.name: Crowdsourced mobile performance
candidates.gate: Postcode-district score is not address-level guarantee.

candidates.name: Coverage checker API
candidates.gate: Respect API terms, vintage and exact join keys.

candidates.name: Outage-status limitation
candidates.gate: Do not infer live operational availability.

candidates.name: Rural broadband disadvantage
candidates.value: Decent, superfast and gigabit behind rest of England
candidates.gate: Rural aggregate cannot be promoted to parcel truth.

candidates.name: Exact UPRN promotion requirement
candidates.value: Corrected source + hash + exact UPRN join
candidates.gate: Canonical parcel promotion remains blocked.
